runtime: installed Windows frozen executable, normal native launch
capture_method: Owned HWND PrintWindow; multiwindow PNGs composed at their actual relative positions on a neutral matte. Input window repositioned before capture.

evidence.events: Synthetic search, write, ready and unknown lifecycle states
evidence.monitor: Three synthetic demo sessions, no real session contents

limitations: Custom mapping and colors, not the default install appearance
Synthetic events do not prove a live provider lifecycle
Owned-window composition, not a full desktop compositor screenshot
Input demonstration does not prove a completed conversation
